Method: Actual product Program.Main, native sampling and rendered WPF control events in a test-owned process. Clipboard compares only owned loopback data; contents never published. Not an external mouse/keyboard automation test.

Checks.Name: Warning and help visible
Checks.Detail: Actual PauseButton and InfoButton routed events on the real 720 by 480 logical window; current help opens separately.

Checks.Name: Minimum-window connection viewport
Checks.Detail: Actual AppList layout height is at least 70 logical pixels.

Checks.Name: Copy column horizontally reachable
Checks.Detail: Actual realized endpoint copy button bounds lie within the DataGrid width; this is a layout check, not a mouse-click test.

Checks.Name: Minimum-window measured layout
Checks.Detail: Actual own-window WPF geometry at the current desktop DPI.

Checks.Name: Real endpoint detail scrolled
Checks.Detail: Actual selected fixture endpoint brought into view at a nonzero DataGrid vertical offset.

Checks.Name: Selection retained across real snapshot 1
Checks.Detail: The actual DataGrid SelectedItem keeps the same real fixture EndpointView object.

Checks.Name: Scroll retained across real snapshot 1
Checks.Detail: Actual nonzero DataGrid VerticalOffset is unchanged after a newer real endpoint sample.

Checks.Name: Observed keyboard focus retained across real snapshot 1
Checks.Detail: Own window foreground and WPF keyboard focus were actually observed.

Checks.Name: Selection retained across real snapshot 2
Checks.Detail: The actual DataGrid SelectedItem keeps the same real fixture EndpointView object.

Checks.Name: Scroll retained across real snapshot 2
Checks.Detail: Actual nonzero DataGrid VerticalOffset is unchanged after a newer real endpoint sample.

Checks.Name: Observed keyboard focus retained across real snapshot 2
Checks.Detail: Own window foreground and WPF keyboard focus were actually observed.

Checks.Name: Selection retained across real snapshot 3
Checks.Detail: The actual DataGrid SelectedItem keeps the same real fixture EndpointView object.

Checks.Name: Scroll retained across real snapshot 3
Checks.Detail: Actual nonzero DataGrid VerticalOffset is unchanged after a newer real endpoint sample.

Checks.Name: Observed keyboard focus retained across real snapshot 3
Checks.Detail: Own window foreground and WPF keyboard focus were actually observed.

Checks.Name: Keyboard focus retention observation
Checks.Detail: Physical focus retention is asserted only while both own-window foreground and WPF keyboard focus are actually observed; otherwise unverified.

Checks.Name: Search empty state
Checks.Detail: Real TextChanged and debounce path.

Checks.Name: Escape restores list
Checks.Detail: Own-window routed PreviewKeyDown; not external keyboard injection.

Checks.Name: Search keyboard focus observation
Checks.Detail: OS foreground focus is not guaranteed in this session; this observation is not a Ctrl+F input test.

Checks.Name: Reset filters restores all
Checks.Detail: Actual reset button when available; older version has no reset control.

Checks.Name: Real endpoint rows materialized
Checks.Detail: Real WPF binding/expansion path.

Checks.Name: Copy endpoint clipboard equality
Checks.Detail: Actual routed CopyEndpoint click; compared only the owned loopback endpoint value.

Checks.Name: Pause preserves timestamp
Checks.Detail: Waited 2.5 seconds with real collector still active.

Checks.Name: Resume updates timestamp
Checks.Detail: Real subsequent sample applied.

Checks.Name: Tray hide
Checks.Detail: Actual routed tray button click; same host process remains alive.

Checks.Name: Single-instance activation exit
Checks.Detail: Second real EXE sees product mutex and returns zero.

Checks.Name: Single-instance restores same window
Checks.Detail: Product activation event calls real ShowWindow path.

Checks.Name: Unique real-icon fixture appears
Checks.Detail: Dedicated executable path; normal Windows executable icon loading.

Checks.Name: Icon fixture exits
Checks.Detail: Graceful owned fixture shutdown.

Checks.Name: App disappears after history retention
Checks.Detail: Waited 65 seconds after dedicated app exited; no other process uses its path.

Checks.Name: Fixture restarts with new PID
Checks.Detail: Same executable path, new actual process.

Checks.Name: Reappeared app gets icon on new view
Checks.Detail: New ApplicationView after 65-second removal has a real non-null icon.

Checks.Name: Eight-process actual endpoint group
Checks.Detail: Eight real same-path child processes, each with one loopback listener.

Checks.Name: Multi-process details render
Checks.Detail: Real small multi-process fixture; no 257-process cache-pressure simulation.

Checks.Name: Original clipboard restored
Checks.Detail: Every materialized original format compared equal; contents stayed in memory only.
